summary: Focused backend+frontend verification completed for category-specific minds, model locks, custom tools/readers, owner-only privacy, robot module behavior, and POST approval flow. All executed checks passed including one real live GPT-5.4 Analyst mission and one live httpbingo POST approval send.

critical_code_review_comments: AgentCreate category defaults are correctly enforced server-side via model validator, preventing frontend bypass.
Custom secret headers are encrypted and omitted from owner-visible/public payloads as expected (header names only exposed).
Action APIs are correctly separated: POST requests remain PENDING until explicit approve and cannot be re-approved (409).
Public endpoints (/api/world, /api/agents) do not leak private customTools or secret header values.

Verified model picker has 9 options with 8 disabled (including Claude), category-specific presets differ and switched-back edits persist, custom draft does not store secret header values, Tools & permissions approve/reject flow works with live https://httpbingo.org/post, repeated approve returns 409 via API test, owned world actor uniqueness validated (single world-{agentId}, no world-you/world-explorer when owner exists), NPC motion observed, and WASD movement changes player position on desktop.
